cn_steps: 在 `Edit > Plugins` 的 Programming 分组启用 `10X Editor Integration`（模块 `N10XSourceCodeAccess`）并重启编辑器。
打开 `Edit > Editor Preferences > General > Source Code`，将 `Source Code Editor` 设为 `10X Editor`。
确认本机已安装 10X Editor，且已对当前引擎/`Source` 生成过工程文件。
在内容浏览器双击 C++ 类，或使用 `Tools > Open IDE` / 同类“打开源代码”入口，应由 `N10XSourceCodeAccess` 把文件交给 10X，而不是 Visual Studio。
从 Class Viewer 或蓝图的 Goto C++ Definition 再验证一次跳转目标。
en_steps: Enable `10X Editor Integration` under `Edit > Plugins` (Programming); it loads `N10XSourceCodeAccess`, then restart.
Open `Edit > Editor Preferences > General > Source Code` and set `Source Code Editor` to `10X Editor`.
Install 10X Editor locally and generate project files for this engine/`Source` tree.
Double-click a C++ class in the Content Browser, or use `Tools > Open IDE` / Open Source Code; `N10XSourceCodeAccess` should hand the file to 10X, not Visual Studio.
Confirm Goto C++ Definition from Class Viewer or a Blueprint also lands in 10X.
note_cn: 这是编辑器源码访问器，不要写进 Game Target 或 Shipping 包。
note_en: Editor-only source accessor; do not link it into a Game target or shipping build.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 插件 `5.8 Gizmo Testing`（描述符 `EditorTRSGizmo.uplugin`，模块 `EditorTRSGizmoTests`）并重启。
在关卡视口选中 Actor，用 W/E/R 切换平移/旋转/缩放，检查新版 TRS Gizmo 的操作手感（不是可放到 Actor 上的游戏组件）。
打开 `Tools > Session Frontend` 的 `Automation` 页，筛选 `EditorTRSGizmo` / TRS Gizmo 相关用例并跑一遍。
不要把 `EditorTRSGizmoTests` 写进游戏模块 `Build.cs` 或包装目标。
仅把它当作验证新 Gizmo 的临时测试插件，不要当正式关卡工具依赖。
en_steps: Enable the Experimental plugin `5.8 Gizmo Testing` (`EditorTRSGizmo.uplugin`, module `EditorTRSGizmoTests`) and restart.
Select an actor in the viewport and use W/E/R to exercise the new TRS gizmo; it is not a gameplay component you add to an actor.
Open `Tools > Session Frontend` → `Automation`, filter `EditorTRSGizmo` / TRS gizmo tests, and run them.
Do not add `EditorTRSGizmoTests` to a game module `Build.cs` or a packaged target.
Treat this as a temporary test harness for the new gizmo, not a production level-editing dependency.
note_cn: Experimental 临时插件，接口可能随夜构建变化。
note_en: Experimental and temporary; the contract can change on nightly builds.

cn_steps: 启用 `Accumulation Depth of Field`（运行时 `AccumulationDOF`，编辑器 `AccumulationDOFEditor`）。
放置 `CineCameraActor`，在 Details 的 `Current Camera Settings` / `Focus Settings` 里设置 Focal Length、Aperture（F-stop）和 Manual Focus Distance。
打开 `Window > Cinematics > Movie Render Queue`（或 Movie Render Graph），把该摄像机加入渲染任务。
提高 Anti-Aliasing 的 Temporal/Spatial Sample Count，让薄透镜孔径采样跨帧累积，而不是依赖实时 Circle DOF。
检查输出序列的焦外散景；不要以 PIE 实时后期为准。
`AccumulationDOFEditor` 只做编辑器细节定制，不要链进 Game Target。
en_steps: Enable `Accumulation Depth of Field` (runtime `AccumulationDOF`, editor `AccumulationDOFEditor`).
Place a `CineCameraActor` and set Focal Length, Aperture (F-stop), and Manual Focus Distance under Details `Current Camera Settings` / `Focus Settings`.
Open `Window > Cinematics > Movie Render Queue` (or Movie Render Graph) and add that camera to the job.
Raise Anti-Aliasing Temporal/Spatial Sample Count so thin-lens aperture samples accumulate across frames instead of using real-time circle DOF.
Judge bokeh on the rendered sequence, not on PIE post-process.
Keep `AccumulationDOFEditor` on an Editor target only.
note_cn: 这是生产/离线累积景深，实时视口观感不能代表最终成像。
note_en: This is production/offline accumulated DOF; the real-time viewport is not the final look.

cn_steps: 启用 `Actor Layer Utilities`（运行时模块 `ActorLayerUtilities`）。
打开 `Window > Layers`，新建 Layer，并把关卡 Actor 拖进层（或在 World Outliner 指定 Layer）。
在 Actor/关卡蓝图中搜索 Layers 分类，调用 `Add Actor to Layer`、`Remove Actor from Layer`、`Get Actors from Layer`（`ULayersBlueprintLibrary`）。
C++ 游戏模块只依赖 `ActorLayerUtilities`，不要依赖 `ActorLayerUtilitiesEditor`。
PIE 中用蓝图查询/改层，对照 `Window > Layers` 面板是否一致。
en_steps: Enable `Actor Layer Utilities` (runtime module `ActorLayerUtilities`).
Open `Window > Layers`, create a layer, and assign level actors (or set Layer in the World Outliner).
In an Actor/Level Blueprint, use the Layers category: `Add Actor to Layer`, `Remove Actor from Layer`, `Get Actors from Layer` (`ULayersBlueprintLibrary`).
Depend on `ActorLayerUtilities` in game modules only; never `ActorLayerUtilitiesEditor`.
In PIE, query or change layers from Blueprint and confirm they match the `Window > Layers` panel.
note_cn: 这是蓝图层 API，不是新的视口绘制模式；层本身仍由 Layers 面板管理。
note_en: This is a Blueprint layer API, not a new viewport mode; layers are still authored in the Layers panel.

cn_steps: 启用 `Actor Modifier Core`（`ActorModifierCore`、`ActorModifierCoreBlueprint`、`ActorModifierCoreEditor`）；要真正的布局/渲染修改器还需同时启用 `Actor Modifier`。
在关卡中选中 Actor，打开 Details 里由 `ActorModifierCoreEditor` 绘制的 Modifier 栈（不是 Sequencer 也不是 nDisplay 面板）。
用 Add Modifier 往栈上挂修改器对象，由 Core 按栈顺序求值。
蓝图侧通过 `ActorModifierCoreBlueprint` 启用/禁用或刷新栈，不要把它当摄像机追踪插件。
自定义修改器应继承 Core 的 Modifier 基类并放在项目模块；`ActorModifierCoreEditor` 仅 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable `Actor Modifier Core` (`ActorModifierCore`, `ActorModifierCoreBlueprint`, `ActorModifierCoreEditor`); turn on `Actor Modifier` as well if you need stock layout/rendering modifiers.
Select a level actor and use the Modifier stack in Details (drawn by `ActorModifierCoreEditor`) — not Sequencer or nDisplay.
Click Add Modifier to push modifier objects onto the stack; Core evaluates them in stack order.
From Blueprint, use `ActorModifierCoreBlueprint` to enable, disable, or refresh the stack; this is not a camera-tracking plugin.
Subclass Core’s modifier base in your module for custom modifiers; keep `ActorModifierCoreEditor` on an Editor target only.
note_cn: Core 只提供修改器栈框架，单独启用看不到布局/渲染成品修改器。
note_en: Core is only the modifier-stack framework; stock layout/rendering modifiers live in the Actor Modifier plugin.

cn_steps: 同时启用 `Actor Modifier Core` 与 `Actor Modifier`（`ActorModifier`、`ActorModifierLayout`、`ActorModifierRendering`）。
选中关卡 Actor，在 Details 的 Modifier 栈点 Add，加入 Layout（阵列/变换）或 Rendering（材质/可见性）类修改器。
改修改器参数并看视口即时结果：多实例排布走 `ActorModifierLayout`，外观覆盖走 `ActorModifierRendering`。
调整栈顺序（自上而下求值），并单独开关某一个修改器做对比。
这是虚拟制片场景布置工具，不要当成 Gameplay Ability 或关卡序列。
`ActorModifierEditor` 只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable both `Actor Modifier Core` and `Actor Modifier` (`ActorModifier`, `ActorModifierLayout`, `ActorModifierRendering`).
Select a level actor, open the Modifier stack in Details, and Add a Layout (array/transform) or Rendering (material/visibility) modifier.
Tweak parameters in the viewport: instance layouts come from `ActorModifierLayout`, look overrides from `ActorModifierRendering`.
Reorder the stack (top-to-bottom evaluation) and toggle individual modifiers to compare.
This is a virtual-production layout tool, not a Gameplay Ability or level sequence.
Keep `ActorModifierEditor` on an Editor target only.
note_cn: 没有 Core 插件时，本插件的具体修改器无法挂到 Actor 栈上。
note_en: Without Actor Modifier Core, these concrete modifiers cannot attach to an actor stack.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 插件 `Actor Palette`（模块 `ActorPalette`）并重启。
打开 `Window > Actor Palette`（不是 `Place Actors` 面板）。
在面板中指定一个已有关卡作为调色板源，列出该关卡里的 Actor。
把条目从调色板拖进当前关卡视口完成摆放。
只用于关卡编辑摆件，不要当运行时对象池或生成器。
en_steps: Enable the Experimental plugin `Actor Palette` (module `ActorPalette`) and restart.
Open `Window > Actor Palette` (not the `Place Actors` panel).
Point the panel at an existing level as the palette source so its actors are listed.
Drag entries from the palette into the current viewport to place them.
Use it only for level-editing placement, not as a runtime pool or spawner.
note_cn: Experimental 编辑器工具，接口可能变动，且不会进 Shipping。
note_en: Experimental editor tool; the UI may change and it does not ship.

cn_steps: 启用 `Actor Sequence (Experimental)`（`ActorSequence` + `ActorSequenceEditor`）。
给目标 Actor 添加 `Actor Sequence Component`（`UActorSequenceComponent`）。
在该组件 Details 里打开内嵌 Sequence，用 Sequencer 对该 Actor 自身做关键帧（不是关卡上的 Level Sequence 资产）。
运行时或蓝图调用组件的 Play 播放这段嵌入序列。
插件名已标明 Experimental；新项目优先用 Level Sequence + Sequencer。
`ActorSequenceEditor` 不要写入 Game Target。
en_steps: Enable `Actor Sequence (Experimental)` (`ActorSequence` + `ActorSequenceEditor`).
Add an `Actor Sequence Component` (`UActorSequenceComponent`) to the actor.
Open the embedded Sequence from the component Details and keyframe that actor in Sequencer (this is not a Level Sequence asset).
At runtime or from Blueprint, call Play on the component to run the embedded sequence.
The plugin is Experimental; prefer Level Sequence + Sequencer for new work.
Do not add `ActorSequenceEditor` to a Game target.
note_cn: 嵌入式 Actor Sequence 仍是实验路径，长期维护请改用 Level Sequence。
note_en: Embedded actor sequences remain experimental; use Level Sequence for anything you must maintain.

cn_steps: 启用 `Adjust Analytics Provider`（`AndroidAdjust`、`IOSAdjust`、`AdjustEditor`）。
在 Adjust 控制台创建应用并复制 App Token。
在 `Project Settings` 的 Analytics 页，或 `DefaultEngine.ini` 的 `[Analytics]`，把 provider 设为 `AndroidAdjust` 或 `IOSAdjust` 并填入 token。
用 `UAnalyticsBlueprintLibrary` 的 `Record Event` / `Record Event with Attributes` 打点，不要找 Window 菜单面板。
打 Android/iOS 开发包，到 Adjust 后台核对事件；桌面 PIE 没有原生 Adjust SDK。
`AdjustEditor` 只用于编辑器里配密钥，不要链进 Game Target。
en_steps: Enable `Adjust Analytics Provider` (`AndroidAdjust`, `IOSAdjust`, `AdjustEditor`).
Create the app in the Adjust dashboard and copy the App Token.
In `Project Settings` Analytics, or `[Analytics]` in `DefaultEngine.ini`, set the provider to `AndroidAdjust` or `IOSAdjust` and paste the token.
Fire events with `UAnalyticsBlueprintLibrary` `Record Event` / `Record Event with Attributes`; there is no Window panel.
Verify on an Android/iOS dev build in the Adjust dashboard; desktop PIE has no native Adjust SDK.
`AdjustEditor` is editor configuration only — keep it off Game targets.
note_cn: 仅 Android/iOS 运行时有效，桌面编辑器里看不到真实归因数据。
note_en: Live only on Android/iOS runtimes; the desktop editor will not show real Adjust attribution.

cn_steps: 启用 `Advanced Professional Video (APV) Decoder for Electra`（模块 `APVDecoderElectra`），并让项目走 Electra 播放器而不是 WMF。
准备 OpenAPV/APV 编码的视频；该解码器不处理 H.264/H.265。
内容浏览器右键 `Media > File Media Source`，指向该文件。
新建 `Media Player`（Electra）和 `Media Texture`，对 Source 执行 Open 后 Play。
把 `Media Texture` 赋给材质采样或 `Media Plate` 进行画面输出。
没有独立 Window 菜单；播不出来时先确认 Player 后端是 Electra 且容器里是 APV 码流。
en_steps: Enable `Advanced Professional Video (APV) Decoder for Electra` (`APVDecoderElectra`) and use Electra, not WMF, as the player.
Supply OpenAPV/APV-encoded video; this decoder does not handle H.264/H.265.
Create `Media > File Media Source` in the Content Browser and point it at that file.
Create an Electra `Media Player` plus a `Media Texture`, then Open the source and Play.
Assign the `Media Texture` to a material sampler or a `Media Plate`.
There is no Window menu; if playback fails, confirm the Electra backend and that the bitstream is APV.
note_cn: 这是 Electra 的 OpenAPV 解码插件，不会在编辑器里注册独立播放窗口。
note_en: This is an Electra OpenAPV decoder only; it does not register a standalone editor player window.

cn_steps: 启用 `AES GCM network packet handler`（模块 `AESGCMHandlerComponent`）。
在客户端与服务器的 `DefaultEngine.ini` 写入 `[PacketHandlerComponents]`，并设置 `Components=AESGCMHandlerComponent`。
配置同一把加密密钥（Project Settings 的 Network encryption / Encryption，或启动参数把 key 同时交给 DS 与客户端）。
用 listen server 或 dedicated server 进关，确认握手后复制包走 AES-GCM 加解密。
这是 `PacketHandler` 管道组件，不能当 `UActorComponent` 加到 Actor 上。
新项目优先用本 GCM 组件，而不是旧的 `AESHandlerComponent`。
en_steps: Enable `AES GCM network packet handler` (module `AESGCMHandlerComponent`).
On both client and server `DefaultEngine.ini`, add `[PacketHandlerComponents]` with `Components=AESGCMHandlerComponent`.
Configure the same encryption key via Project Settings Network encryption / Encryption, or pass the key to both DS and clients at launch.
Join via listen or dedicated server and confirm replication is AES-GCM encrypted after handshake.
This is a `PacketHandler` pipeline component, not a `UActorComponent` you add to an actor.
Prefer this GCM handler over the older `AESHandlerComponent` for new projects.
note_cn: 客户端与服务器必须使用相同的 PacketHandler 列表和密钥，否则无法完成加密握手。
note_en: Client and server must share the same PacketHandler list and key or the encrypted handshake will fail.

cn_steps: 启用 `AES network packet handler`（模块 `AESHandlerComponent`）。
在两端 `DefaultEngine.ini` 的 `[PacketHandlerComponents]` 设置 `Components=AESHandlerComponent`（组件名与 GCM 插件不同）。
配置预共享 AES 密钥，保证 dedicated server 与客户端一致。
联机进关验证加密通道；该实现没有 GCM 那种认证标签。
不要在蓝图组件列表里搜索并添加这个 Handler。
能进 Shipping，但安全上更推荐改用 `AESGCMHandlerComponent`。
en_steps: Enable `AES network packet handler` (module `AESHandlerComponent`).
Set `[PacketHandlerComponents]` `Components=AESHandlerComponent` in both ends’ `DefaultEngine.ini` (a different component name from the GCM plugin).
Configure a pre-shared AES key so dedicated server and clients match.
Join a networked session to verify the encrypted channel; this path has no GCM authentication tag.
Do not search Blueprint component lists to add this handler onto an actor.
It can ship, but `AESGCMHandlerComponent` is the stronger choice.
note_cn: 旧版 AES 包处理，缺少 GCM 完整性校验，新项目应改用 AES-GCM。
note_en: Legacy AES packet encryption without GCM integrity; new projects should use AES-GCM instead.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 的 `Agent Capability`（`AgentCapability`），通常与编辑器 AI / Toolset 插件一起开。
本插件做被动发现：扫描已配置的 agent 插件和工作区能力，没有关卡 Actor 或 Window 面板工作流。
把 Claude/Codex 等 agent 清单和工作区说明放到项目约定目录，供发现逻辑读取。
需要回归时在 `Tools > Session Frontend` 跑 `AgentCapabilityTests`，不要当游戏子系统调用。
发现结果给其他 agent/toolset 消费，而不是给你一条可玩的 AI 角色。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `Agent Capability` (`AgentCapability`), usually together with editor AI / Toolset plugins.
It performs passive discovery of configured agent plugins and workspace capabilities; there is no level-actor or Window-panel workflow.
Place Claude/Codex agent manifests and workspace instruction files where the project expects them so discovery can read them.
Run `AgentCapabilityTests` from `Tools > Session Frontend` when you need a regression; do not treat this as a game subsystem.
Other agent/toolset plugins consume the results; it does not spawn a playable AI character.
note_cn: Experimental 编辑器发现层，不进 Shipping，接口会随夜构建变化。
note_en: Experimental editor discovery layer; it does not ship and the contract can change nightly.

cn_steps: 启用 `Agent Plugin Toolset`（`AgentPluginToolset`、`AgentPluginToolsetEditor`），并同时打开 AI Toolset Registry。
在项目工作目录放入 Claude/Codex 代理插件清单，以及 `AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md` 这类指令文件。
重启或刷新后，Registry 通过本插件枚举这些插件与工作目录指令。
在编辑器 AI 助手里确认工具已注册可用；这与 `AIModule` 行为树无关。
`AgentPluginToolsetEditor` 仅 Editor Target；`AgentPluginToolsetTests` 用 Session Frontend 跑。
en_steps: Enable `Agent Plugin Toolset` (`AgentPluginToolset`, `AgentPluginToolsetEditor`) together with the AI Toolset Registry.
Put Claude/Codex agent plugin manifests and working-directory instruction files such as `AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md` in the project.
After restart or refresh, the Registry enumerates those plugins and instructions through this toolset.
Confirm the tools appear in the in-editor AI assistant; this is unrelated to `AIModule` behavior trees.
Keep `AgentPluginToolsetEditor` on an Editor target; run `AgentPluginToolsetTests` from Session Frontend.
note_cn: Experimental 编辑器 Toolset，给 AI 助手读插件/指令，不进游戏包。
note_en: Experimental editor toolset that feeds the AI assistant; it is not a shipping game feature.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 插件 `AI Assistant`（模块 `AIAssistant`）并重启。
从编辑器 `Window` 菜单或工具栏打开 AI Assistant 聊天面板（编辑器内助手，不是 `AIModule` 行为树）。
按面板提示完成登录或模型选择后，针对当前资产、蓝图或关卡提问。
若要让助手调用工作区工具，再启用 `Agent Capability` 与 `Agent Plugin Toolset`。
官方 Description 为空，面板入口和 API 会变；不要把 `AIAssistant` 加进 Shipping。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `AI Assistant` (module `AIAssistant`) and restart.
Open the AI Assistant chat from the editor `Window` menu or toolbar (an in-editor assistant, not `AIModule` behavior trees).
Sign in or pick a model as the panel requires, then ask about the current asset, Blueprint, or level.
Enable `Agent Capability` and `Agent Plugin Toolset` as well if the assistant should call workspace tools.
Epic ships no Description; the panel and API can change — do not add `AIAssistant` to Shipping.
note_cn: Experimental 编辑器助手，无稳定官方说明，不能当运行时游戏 AI。
note_en: Experimental in-editor assistant with no stable official description; it is not runtime game AI.
